alyssa (oncall): I'm on pager. seeing lots of 429s from runtime. starting triage.
alyssa (oncall): grabbing HPA status now.
marcus (sre): joining. i'll pull k8s events and autoscaler logs.

mateo (infra): checking cloud nodepool and quota, stand by.

marcus (sre): autoscaler logs: `no scale: metrics not found` repeated. looks like HPA sync loop can't read metrics.

```
E0503 21:34:12 adapter.go:214] query error: upstream request timed out
E0503 21:34:13 adapter.go:214] failed to transform result: unexpected response size
```
priya (runtime): also seeing `OOMKilled` on adapter pod for one replica during the spike.
ops-bot: autoscaler: "skipping scale event, reason=MetricUnavailable"
mateo (infra): cloud nodepool quota for GPUs is at 10/12, autoscaler attempted to request 3 but cloud rejected due to project limit. raising quota request now. ticket CLOUD-12345 created.
alyssa (oncall): immediate plan: 1) try to restore metrics (restart adapter), 2) emergency manual scale for deployment if needs capacity, 3) request quota bump.
marcus (sre): i recommend restart adapter first. if it's OOM maybe increase memory or roll to a different image.
priya (runtime): restarting now: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/prometheus-adapter -n monitoring`
alyssa (oncall): restart issued. watching pods.
priya (runtime): new adapter pod crashed on first attempt, reason: spike in query volume during restart causing memory exhaustion.
allyssa? (note: typo)
alyssa (oncall): (typo ignore)
mateo (infra): cloud support acknowledged quota request, ETA 45m for manual review.
yana (customer-success): are customers impacted? seeing backlog for AcmeCorp and BetaApp in support dashboard. some timeouts reported.
alyssa (oncall): yes, CS: 12 unique requests failed with 429/timeout in last 10m. I'll draft a customer-facing note.
priya (runtime): alternative mitigation: scale pods manually to relieve queue while adapter is warming up. HPA will be ineffective until metrics resume.
marcus (sre): agreed. manual scale is safest short term. we should avoid adding too many pods if nodequota blocks scheduling.
alyssa (oncall): executing manual scale: `kubectl scale deployment/gpu-inference -n runtime --replicas=8` -> applied.
ops-bot: deployment/gpu-inference scaled to 8 replicas.
alyssa (oncall): some pods are pending due to insufficient GPU nodes.
mateo (infra): launching additional nodes via cloud console where quota allows; we can get 2 nodes immediate, rest pending quota approval.
priya (runtime): adapter logs now show some successful scrapes: `200 OK` for /api/v1/query_range for custom metric, latency high but not timing out.
marcus (sre): `kubectl get hpa -n runtime gpu-inference-hpa` -> desiredReplicas shows 8 now, metrics name=external.queue_length value captured. HPA should resume auto-scaling soon.
yana (customer-success): preparing customer update: "We observed degraded inference throughput due to autoscaling delays; manual scaling and mitigation in progress; normal service expected within 30-45 minutes." sending in 10.
alyssa (oncall): queue length trending down from 4.8k -> 2.3k over last 12m. per-pod CPU still elevated.
priya (runtime): note: root cause appears to be high-cardinality custom metrics queries causing prometheus-adapter memory spikes. possibly linked to last week's rollout of per-customer labels in queue exporter.
marcus (sre): creating incident doc and will include timeline, commands run, log snippets, and follow-ups: revert high-cardinality labels, add adapter resource limits, and add synthetic health check for adapter metrics endpoint.
mateo (infra): cloud quota ticket updated: provisional increase granted to 12 GPUs, provisioning in progress.
alyssa (oncall): handing off to night oncall in 40m. checklist for next oncall: confirm HPA metrics stable for 30m, monitor queue <1k, validate no OOMs for adapter, confirm cloud quota final.
yana (customer-success): sent customer update. will escalate if we see regressions.
priya (runtime): temporary config change to adapter: increase memory to 1.5Gi and enable backoff on large queries. will put as emergency change in monitoring namespace.
marcus (sre): ack. schedule a postmortem meeting tomorrow 10:00 PT. owners: runtime, infra, sre.
alyssa (oncall): severity downgraded to Sev3; mitigations applied. leaving this thread to be monitored; will update if anything changes. :thumbsup:
